svg.title: IconChevronLeft
svg.desc: Placement steppers for a Kitchen reference layer, from variant B of docs/design/mockups/explorations/reference-panel-variants.html (its UP/DOWN glyphs, copied verbatim). Chevrons rather than arrows because a gap stepper nudges by one slot; the locked set has no reference panel and so no glyph for this. Authored in the same 24-unit box as every icon here and sized by the ico classes, never inline. Horizontal chevrons for the inspector's prev/next. The vertical pair below is the same stroke rotated, but a rotated Path.ico would fight the shared 24-unit scale transform, so these are traced in the box like every other glyph.
